steps.say: Some things will happen and some things might happen. Some things will not happen at all.
This bag has only sweets. If you pick one, you will pick a sweet.
This bag has sweets and cookies. You might pick a cookie.

figure.alt: A bag with 4 sweets and 2 cookies.

steps.say: There are no apples in the bag. Picking an apple will not happen.
There are more sweets than cookies, so a sweet is more likely.

hints: Look at what is in the bag.

check.explanation: There are no marbles in the bag, so picking a marble will not happen.

options.why: There are shells in the bag, so it might happen.

options.text: You pick a shell or a button.

check.prompt: A bag has 2 apples and 6 oranges. Which are you more likely to pick?

hints: Count each kind in the bag.
The kind with more in the bag is more likely.
check.explanation: There are 6 oranges and only 2 apples, so you are more likely to pick an orange.
